description: Run one Premiere Pro operation by name (see pr_catalog), e.g. {"operation":"add_marker","args":{"time_seconds":1.5,"name":"Intro"}}. Returns the operation result JSON. Writes are verified by readback where Premiere allows it. A result with undoSteps / undoStackIndex can be reverted with the undo operation {expected_undo_stack_index}; property and marker writes record no undo step — checkpoint the sequence before them. Prefer this over writing ExtendScript.
name: pr_do
